lines.t: Before empires rose, before doctrines hardened, the most high spoke and the way was walked.
I stood at the gate where two roads divide One loud with promise, one quiet with life
The crowd moved fast, their hands held high But truth stood still and met my eyes
It didn't offer silver or a throne It asked for my heart, my will, my bones
Leave what you were, come walk and see Said the living word, calling me
Not written on stone alone, but carved in a heart when the proud let go
Not hearers of words, but walkers made new, a covenant lived, faithful and true
I follow the footstep in the dust
Where truth stays sharp and pride turns to rust
Not my way, not the voice of men
I walk the path he walked back then
Through fire refined, through faith aligned
Breath of the Most High filling my lungs
I won't turn back, I won't delay
I walk the way
He touched the outcast, spoke straight to kings
Called out the lie, wrapped in hollow things
He honored the Torah, fulfilled it in light
Lived every word, not one denied
No mask, no blend with the world's applause
He stood unmoved by the threat of loss
Servant's hands, yet authority clear
The kingdom's drawn near, right here
Repent means turn, not feel regret
Change direction, place your steps
Wide road packed, but the soul runs dry
Narrow stays quiet, but the truth stays alive
Commands ain't changed, they're life in motion
Written within, fueled by devotion Not religion, not culture, not man-made flame
Set apart, living, branded by name Obedience ain't easy, it cuts through the night
Follow the way, stand up and fight Dust on your feet, fire in your heart
Every small step is a brand new start Turn from the wide, step into light
Every breath living, walk in his sight No compromise, no half measures taken
Life fully given when the king awakens
Strip me clean of borrowed names
Teach my feet your ancient ways
If it costs me all I've been
Let obedience be how I win
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Truth before comfort, obedience first
From dawn to dusk
From breath to grave
I choose the life the Father gave
No turning back
No divided way
The narrow path
Is where I'll stay
Not tradition
tradition, not the world, only truth, lived in Yahushua.
Thank you for watching.
